title: Craftsman
dek: Combine components and materials into magic items.
body:
← Crafting & Skill Experience

Craftsmen serve as the final stop on the production chain for magic items in Fenumion. They take the Components painstakingly gathered by Hunters and the Materials gathered by Scouts and/or meticulously refined by Smiths and combine them to create magic items.

Seeking a legendary recipe? Thalanbor the Boundless Artwright’s craftlore names rare treasures to pursue, including his forge hammer and chisel. These recipe requirements sit alongside the trade rules below.

The Craftsman Progression Table

Craftsman · table 1
Skill LevelSkill Exp. RequiredAbilities
Apprentice1,000Allows the crafting of Common and Uncommon magic items that don't require attunement, given the proper supplies
+2 to Crafting Rolls
Journeyman4,000Allows the crafting of any Common or Uncommon magic items, as well as Rare items that don't require attunement, given the proper supplies
+4 to Crafting Rolls
Expert10,000Allows the crafting of any Rare magic items, as well as Very Rare magic items that don’t require attunement, given the proper supplies
+6 to Crafting Rolls
Master20,000Allows the crafting of any Very Rare and all Legendary Items, given the proper supplies
+8 to Crafting Rolls

How it Works

To create, the craftsman rolls a d20 and adds to it their proficiency bonus and their skill level modifier. Another craftsman of the same skill level or higher may use the Help action to give advantage on the roll. The Artificer class feature Magic Item Adept/Savant/Master confers an additional bonus to the refining roll of +1, +2, or +3, depending on the highest level of this feature for that Artificer. This roll cannot be modified in any way except as outlined in this skill description. The DC to successfully craft depends on the rarity of the magic item as defined below:

Common: DC 5

Uncommon: DC 10

Rare: DC 17

Very Rare: DC 25

Legendary: DC 33

To craft a permanent magic item of a given rarity requires a wide variety of supplies, including Components gathered from monsters by Hunters and Materials, which are obtained by Scouts and possibly refined by Smiths. Items requiring attunement generally require more and higher rarity materials than their non-attunement counterparts, as illustrated below. An adventurer may carry up to 5 consumable magic items (potions and scrolls) and are limited to carrying the same rarities as other magic items, as detailed in #server-specific-rule.

Given a large enough supply of Components and Materials, there is no limit on how many times per day a Crafter may make crafting rolls. However, be aware that if a roll fails by more than double your skill modifier bonus, the attempt destroys half of the Components and Materials involved and a natural 1 on the crafting roll destroys all Components and Materials involved.

Read the Fenumion Skill Descriptions source document. The reference retains its mechanics and wording.
